output.name: Part release blocked by incomplete classification / missing required attributes
output.summary: Engineers try to release parts and are blocked because the part has no class or its required classification attributes are empty, and they don't know which class to pick (e.g. cable glands), so they raise a ticket and wait about a day for support to walk them through it.

root_cause.text: Likely the classification step is only enforced at release time, with no guidance at part creation on which class to choose or which attributes are required, so users discover the gap only when release is blocked.

quotes.quote: Part will not release, says classification incomplete.
Release of 100-005849 is blocked: required attribute missing.
Which class do I pick for a cable gland?

evidence.text: Every ticket is resolved the same way, by support manually helping the user choose a class and fill attributes, showing a knowledge or guidance gap rather than a system defect.

quotes.quote: Helped user pick the class and fill required attributes.
Helped user pick the class and fill required attributes.

evidence.text: The same question about which class fits a cable gland recurs across many tickets, suggesting one or more commodity types have no obvious class mapping.

quotes.quote: Which class do I pick for a cable gland?
Which class do I pick for a cable gland?
Which class do I pick for a cable gland?

evidence.text: The block hits parts across different number ranges, so it is not limited to one part family.

quotes.quote: Release of 450-004687 is blocked: required attribute missing.
Release of 210-006891 is blocked: required attribute missing.
Release of 330-007313 is blocked: required attribute missing.

evidence.text: The release error tells users classification is incomplete but not what to do, so they open tickets titled with the error itself.

output.fix: Move classification to part creation: require a class when the part is created, with a guided class picker that maps common commodity types (starting with cable glands) to their class, and validate required attributes as they are entered. When release is blocked, the error message should name the missing attributes and link to KB-402.
